text.en: Many customers are delighted with skilled haircuts on bernedoodles, sweet Persian cats, and sanitary trims, noting that pleasant scents last for days. Conversely, several dissatisfied clients complained about uneven coats, hair trimmed too short against instructions, and shaving a double-coated husky without owner approval.

title.en: Caring daycare team and attentive groomers

text.en: Reviewers praise groomer Claudia and the daycare team for their warmth, friendliness, and dedication to keeping dogs entertained. While one client noted frustration over unexpected appointment delays and customer service, the majority of pet parents describe the staff as genuinely affectionate and attentive.

Most pet owners share that their pets love spending time at the facility, highlighting that daycare dogs play eagerly while long-haired cats remain relaxed during sanitary trims. A single review reported a toy puppy trembling from rough handling, though most clients observe happy dogs enjoying active play.

q.en: Do they provide photo updates during dog daycare?

a.en: Yes, daycare clients report receiving pictures and videos throughout the day showing their dogs playing with staff.

q.en: Can cats be booked for grooming and sanitary trims?

a.en: Yes, the salon handles long-haired cats and Persians for baths, lion cuts, and sanitary trims.

q.en: How are styling lengths communicated before grooming?

a.en: Groomers provide length charts to choose styling levels, though clients emphasize confirming specific coat preferences clearly.
